summary: In commercial spaceflight, SpaceX achieved a major milestone by successfully returning its Starship upper stage from orbit and capturing it with launch pad arms for the first time, though the company is currently investigating a booster catch abort following an explosion that prevented a dual recovery. In civil space exploration, NASA's Voyager 1 probe is nearing a distance of one light-day from Earth in interstellar space, establishing a new distance record. On the defense front, the U.S. Air Force has outlined a plan to deploy connectivity upgrades across its tanker and airlift fleets. In scientific developments, the Euclid satellite revealed a record number of cosmic gravitational lenses, while separate observations challenged existing evidence of an outsized black hole in the early universe and an independent study examined the accuracy of an iconic black hole image. Additionally, astronomers identified three star-forming cores at distinct stages inside a single gas clump, investigated sudden luminosity dips in aging stars, and reported preliminary research suggesting a common food emulsifier could resolve a long-standing rocket fuel issue. Skywatchers can look to the night sky as Jupiter and Mars make a close approach overnight from Nov. 15 to Nov. 16.
